name: MikeBuildsApp
subtitle: Unsigned IPAs by MikeBuilds: BuildBox, TendieMaker, Layers
description: Official source for MikeBuilds apps. Every IPA ships unsigned (Sami-Wali model) - sign it with BuildBox, ESign, SideStore or AltStore. Support: Telegram t.me/MikeBuildsApp - Discord discord.gg/vjJ9rZDNsg

apps.name: BuildBox
apps.subtitle: Compile, sign and install iOS apps from your iPhone
apps.localizedDescription: Compile Swift apps straight from your iPhone (GitHub Actions backend), then sign them on-device with your own certificate and install - the full cycle in one app. It can also import any IPA just to sign it, and inject .deb/.zip tweak packages before signing. Ships as an unsigned IPA. Free with a donate button.

versions.localizedDescription: New: set a .tendie as an animated wallpaper inside BuildBox. Catalog buttons refreshed and About updated. Requires iOS 18+.
Fixes a crash when signing large IPAs (like Instagram). BuildBox now appears in the Files app. Requires iOS 18+.

Icon perfected: the planet of apps blueprint grid redrawn clean - crisp single lines at any size. Button fix: Download and Sign in the Catalog (Featured carousel and app rows) and Install in the Library now respond across the whole button, not just the text. Requires iOS 18+.

Icon refined: the planet of apps now shows its blueprint grid - same artwork, design lines visible at any size. Button fix: Download and Sign in the Catalog (Featured carousel and app rows) and Install in the Library now respond across the whole button, not just the text. Requires iOS 18+.

New official icon - the planet of apps, designed by Miguel. Change any app's icon in Sign (Files or Photos) and inject .deb/.zip tweak packages on-device before signing. Signed apps show a profile-expiry countdown; share unsigned IPAs from the Catalog; Clear Cache in Settings. Open With fixed for .ipa files. Languages: English, Espanol and Arabic with full RTL layout. Requires iOS 18+.

Catalog-first redesign (Catalog home tab, Sources as a sheet, restyled Signed tab), signing fixed (release apps open again, catalog signing no longer closes the app), Catalog refresh, Clear All logs, matching page titles; requires iOS 18+.
New Sources + Add App tabs, reworked Sign tab (certificate page, collapsible App Info, pinned Signature/Install), real-signature Install check, frosted tab bar and a pro About.
Tweak package injection (.deb/.zip) at sign time, sign reliability fixes, Library Install button and Copy Log improvements.

apps.name: TendieMaker
apps.subtitle: Make .tendie live wallpapers from your own videos
apps.localizedDescription: Turn your videos into .tendie live wallpapers right on your iPhone. Includes a built-in gallery of community tendies. Ships as an unsigned IPA - sign it with BuildBox, ESign, SideStore or AltStore. Free with a donate button.

versions.localizedDescription: Real preview, playback speed, and Files import.

apps.name: Layers
apps.subtitle: Icon borders, dock tint and depth shadows in your wallpaper
apps.localizedDescription: Bakes icon borders, dock tint and depth shadows into your wallpaper at the exact icon-grid positions - home screen customization, no jailbreak. Ships as an unsigned IPA - sign it with BuildBox, ESign, SideStore or AltStore. Free with a donate button.

versions.localizedDescription: Effect presets (Soft/Medium/Strong pills for Depth shadow and 3D border); tighter 3D frame and smaller shadows.
Saved layouts now fully visible and deletable.
Fixed Export not saving to Photos.
Fixed app images not rendering in sideloaded installs.
